Chapter 686: Chapter 1: Sudden Increase in Strength (Please Subscribe)

Deep within the cosmic starry skies, whether it be an Eleventh-Rank Life or an Ancient God,

or even the ultimate existences, they were all certain it was a Tenth-Rank who had comprehended the Rule of Time, currently breaking through to Tier 11.

Because the fissure in the universe that had been torn open, and the Chaos Void Origin that was pouring in, were much lower than the shock of an Eleventh Rank Peak reaching its ultimate state.

But the Xia Qin Supreme Being and the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being knew it was not so.

The cause of such a grand disturbance was merely the Galaxy Master breaking through to the Tenth Rank.

From the Ninth Rank breaking through to the Tenth Rank.

...

This left both Supreme Beings somewhat bewildered.

Even though they had high expectations for Lin Yuan, thinking that the gap torn during the breakthrough would be around ten million miles,

this was already overestimating Lin Yuan, for normally, a Ninth-Rank breakthrough to the Tenth Rank would tear a gap in the universe of only about a million miles.

A special Ninth Rank might manage to tear a two to three million-mile gap, but that was the limit.

And the aforementioned gaps torn during a breakthrough were merely internal gaps within the universe, infused with the Origin Source of the universe.

However, comprehending the Rule of Time and having a complete, independent inner world, the fissure torn in the universe would connect to the external Chaos Void.

The quality of Chaos Void Origin is far higher than that of the universe’s Origin Source, and if the Galaxy Master hadn’t developed over two hundred million Spatial Layers, the Xia Qin Supreme Being might even think that the gap torn during the breakthrough was less than a million miles.

“The gap torn in the universe over twelve light-years, Chaos Void Origin Infusion, such disturbance… shouldn’t appear when breaking from the Ninth Rank to the Tenth Rank, right?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being and the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being looked puzzled.

It wasn’t that they doubted Lin Yuan, but they found the scene before them somewhat incredible.

A Temporal Life that had comprehended the Rule of Time, when breaking through to Tier 11, could potentially tear a gap in the universe up to ten light-years.

But that would be at the Tenth Rank, having gone through a Ninth Rank breakthrough, even if it were only infused with the universe’s Origin Source, it would still result in a tremendous metamorphosis of their Physical Soul, Spirit Will, and Inner World.

Additionally, during the Tenth Rank, various Fusion Rules were constantly comprehended and absorbed into the Inner World, significantly enhancing the Inner World’s accumulated foundation.

And these enhancements could not be made up for by merely developing an extra one or two hundred million Spatial Layers.

When a Ninth Rank Life develops more Spatial Layers, it can indeed add some foundation for stepping into the Tenth Rank, but it’s only a bit. The various Fusion Rules comprehended during the Tenth Rank, especially the Fusion of Pillar-level Rules,

would offer greater assistance to a Tenth Rank Life.

The Galaxy Master had only comprehended the Rule of Time and had not yet discovered even a single pillar-level Fusion Rule, so how could he withstand the infusion of so much Chaos Void Origin?

…

Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being were full of doubts in their hearts, but the commotion of the breakthrough before their eyes was real and genuine, with an endless downpour of Chaos Void Origin.

“This little guy…”

“Must have a big secret.” Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being glanced at each other, “It’s likely that the strength he’s showing now in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is just for show.”

Given the amount of Chaos Void Origin that Lin Yuan is bearing now, the Galaxy Master’s accumulated foundation at the Ninth Rank must be incredibly strong.

If he had only developed two hundred million Spatial Layers, how could he possibly bear the infusion of so much Chaos Void Origin?

“Excellent! Excellent! Excellent!”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s eyes shone bright.

Originally he thought that Lin Yuan comprehending the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank had already been a huge surprise.

But there were even greater surprises yet to come.

Given the commotion Lin Yuan had caused during his breakthrough, it seemed that upon entering the Tenth Rank, he would be comparable to those at the Peak Tenth Rank on the Grade A list.

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being also smiled.

The two Supreme Beings did not blame the Galaxy Master for having concealed anything from them.

To grow, it was necessary to hide oneself.

Before the beginning of the Starry Sea Era, human civilization’s long years of lying dormant were also spent desperately hiding itself.

Not hide? In its weaker days, human civilization would have been divided up by the different species and Supreme Beings already.

As for the great secrets and great opportunities on Lin Yuan?

Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being didn’t care.

No matter how great the secret, could it compare to the grand secrets once obtained by human civilization?

No matter how great the opportunity, could it compare to the grand opportunities once obtained by human civilization?

…

Deep within the Spatial Layers.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, above his head, the twelve-light-year-wide gap connecting to the Chaos Void rapidly healed.

The time for bearing Origin Source infusion during a breakthrough from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank was fixed at three hundred thirty-three seconds.

Hence the more profound the foundation of the breaking Ninth Rank, the larger the gap would be; under the same duration, to satisfy different foundations of Ninth-Rank Life breaking through to the Tenth Rank, the only variable is the size of the gap.

The larger the gap, the more Origin Source is infused in three hundred thirty-three seconds.

The gap Lin Yuan tore in the universe during his breakthrough reached twelve light-years; even though the duration remained only three hundred thirty-three seconds, the amount of Origin Source obtained was immeasurable.

At this moment, Lin Yuan felt as if he was ‘stuffed.’

His True Body, both Primordial Spirit Avatars, were all ‘stuffed full.’

“Finally stepped into the Tenth Rank…” Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his spirit invigorated.

Even the most ordinary Tenth Rank, after experiencing the infusion of the universe’s Origin Source, would see their strength increase by a hundred or a thousand times compared to their Ninth Rank state.

And Lin Yuan had experienced an infusion of Chaos Void Origin, naturally attaining a greater increase, his Physical Soul, Spirit Will, and Inner World, all reaching new heights.

“Just… the commotion I caused during the breakthrough must not have been small, right?” Lin Yuan glanced at the space above, where the gap had completely ‘healed.’
